rules.rule: Use the approved product accent only for the roles listed in the repo design system.
rules.check: Compare rendered controls in both themes with the repo design-system reference page.
rules.violation: A neutral navigation control adopts the accent without an approved role.

rules.rule: Configure client-specific outside services only through the repo-approved client administration boundary.
rules.check: Trace configuration ownership to the client identity and approved boundary named in repo instructions.
rules.violation: A client secret is placed in a shared application environment.

rules.rule: Describe this product missing-input flow as explicit questions and confirmations, as required by the repo.
rules.check: Compare published claims with the actual question flow defined in repo acceptance criteria.
rules.violation: Copy promises automatic inference where this product asks the user.

rules.rule: Run the repo-defined multilingual, multi-turn staging acceptance suite and add owner-found bugs to it.
rules.check: Read acceptance suite evidence for the exact scenario matrix in repo instructions.
rules.violation: Only a single-language happy path is checked.

rules.rule: Use plain punctuation without em dashes or emojis in user-visible text.
rules.check: Run check-practices for em-dash candidates; inspect visibility and emoji use.
rules.violation: A button label contains an em dash.
sources: Repo owner typography decision, record its date and approval here when adopting
